method: Noise-weighted least-squares projection of frozen DGF A/E output onto eight exact response basis functions, followed by source-strain synthesis. Four injected fundamental modes, two phase quadratures per mode.
conditions: Injected detector-frame mass, remnant spin, sky position, inclination, polarization, arrival epoch, and the simulated ringup history are fixed. Coefficients are fitted from the model output. This is a conditional source reconstruction with a strong waveform prior, not an independent source-parameter recovery.
source_display: Post-reference 0 to 4 tau220; h+ and hcross use the original 0.5-s source sampling. The reference epoch is the source model t=0. The A/E suppression interval has a distributed source-time response, so no single source-time gap is shaded.
weighted_fit: Both A/E channels jointly; frozen calibration PSD; DC and Nyquist excluded; column-normalized least squares rcond=1e-10.
noise_display: Top two rows show the original full A/E observation and signal-suppression interval. Bottom rows show s+Pn where P is the same fixed conditional source projection used on DGF output and n is the original realized A/E noise. Gray filling joins s to s+Pn; it is one noise realization, not an uncertainty band. Noise amplitudes are unscaled. The low-rank QNM projection makes Pn correlated and smooth.
